|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">マクシミリアン・ヴィアーズ将軍は帝国地上軍将校の模範である。狡猾で忠誠心が強く、敵にとっては致命的までに有能な<u>リーダー</u>。ベイダーの軍団で地上攻撃部隊を指揮する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' General Veers

'''Card text:''' Power +1 if at the same location as Admiral Ozzel. Each Imperial at the same location on Hoth has power +1. Adds 3 to the power of the combat vehicle he pilots. On Blizzard 1, adds 1 to armor and may draw one battle destiny even when unable to draw one otherwise.

'''Lore:''' General Maximilian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. A cunning and loyal leader, so capable as to be deadly to his enemies. Commands the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.
